entities.name: Kikunae Ikeda
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Kikunae Ikeda  was a Japanese chemist and Tokyo Imperial University professor of chemistry who, in 1908, uncovered the chemical basis of a taste he named umami. It is one of the five basic tastes along with sweet, bitter, sour and salty.
